V2-ADMISSION.coverage: finite explicit witnesses; not a new normative ERC requirement
V2-ADMISSION.requirement: Exact v2 claim with unchanged v0/v1 admission; no independent-controller or judgment-truth claim.

V2-AVAILABILITY.coverage: finite explicit witnesses; not a new normative ERC requirement
V2-AVAILABILITY.requirement: Missing, malformed or unverified request-role evidence cannot authorize.

V2-BINDING.coverage: finite explicit witnesses; not a new normative ERC requirement
V2-BINDING.requirement: Bind all four exact eth_call inputs/results to identity registry, agent, validator, request, chain and receipt block; contradictions are REFUTED.

V2-ROLES.coverage: finite explicit witnesses; not a new normative ERC requirement
V2-ROLES.requirement: No observed request-block owner/global-operator/token-approval/agentWallet overlap; zero wallet is an established empty role, not missing evidence.

V2-SIGNATURE.coverage: finite explicit witnesses; not a new normative ERC requirement
V2-SIGNATURE.requirement: Pinned setAgentWallet requires new-wallet EIP-712/1271 signature and an authorized caller. These vectors execute EIP-712 EOA path only.

V2-TIME.coverage: finite explicit witnesses; not a new normative ERC requirement
V2-TIME.requirement: Request-block roles govern; subsequent changes cannot replace them.

V2-TRANSFER.coverage: finite explicit witnesses; not a new normative ERC requirement
V2-TRANSFER.requirement: Pinned IdentityRegistryUpgradeable._update clears agentWallet on transfer.
